waypoints.name: Pass Creek Road End
waypoints.directions: From Idaho Highway 28 in the Birch Creek Valley on the east side of the Lemhi Range, turn west on the signed Pass Creek Road, north of the old Blue Dome site. After the first couple of miles the road fords Pass Creek and turns rough; stay on the main track through a gate into the national forest. It ends as jeep tracks at a small saddle with a fire ring at about 8,000 ft, where parties park.

waypoints.name: Diamond Peak
waypoints.directions: Follow the old jeep track and a worn climbers' path west up grassy slopes to a saddle near 9,300 ft, then climb the steep ridge to about 10,200 ft, where it bends northwest. Around 11,000 ft a series of 10 to 30 ft rock steps is best taken close to the crest, followed by a long stretch of Class 2 and 3 scrambling on or just left of the crest to the summit.
